title: 5 AI tools gamers are using to get unfair advantages

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if AI tools are reshaping competitive gaming — for better or worse?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: AI-driven aim trainers and bot-assisted gameplay are already common in esports.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: This erodes fair play and devalues human skill in a competitive space.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Developers are adding detection algorithms and watermarking AI outputs.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: We could see AI as a training aid, not a crutch, in the next 5 years.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of gaming may balance AI and human mastery — not one replacing the other.

video_cue: A split-screen showing a human gamer and an AI-assisted gamer facing off in a futuristic arena.
